brief:
All 27 EU member states have agreed that Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank violate international law and backed trade sanctions against them, according to Middle East Eye. The consensus was reached during discussions led by the EU's High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy. The unified position reflects agreement across the bloc that the settlements contravene international legal standards.

The decision paves the way for the EU to proceed with implementing a trade sanctions framework against the settlements. The agreement comes as the bloc continues to grapple with its policy stance on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and efforts to address violations of international law in occupied territories.

title: EU member states unanimously back trade sanctions on Israeli settlements
